name: team_planning_cost
description: Get what a scenario of a Team Planning plan the caller is in costs over its period, beside the baseline priced over the same days, with the difference. Each seat (a person, or the FTE a position's occupants leave open) is priced at the midpoint of the pay band for its level and country (else the band for any location), made yearly (a month is 1/12, an hour takes the working_hours rule), scaled by FTE and by the days it is held out of the year (365, or the run rate's own year: 366 across a 29 February), plus the on_cost rule of its unit. A person is priced at their own level, a planned one winning, and at their position's level only when theirs resolves to none; level_source says which. A leaver costs up to their leaving date and their backfill from the day after. Totals are per currency in `native`, and `converted` is the same in the reference currency at the period's start, null with `missing` saying why when a rate is missing. Units count their own places, with null for no unit; `with_below` adds the units below. Cost centres use null for no cost centre. A person's seat takes the person's cost centre. A placeholder hire's seat and an open seat take their position's own cost centre, else its occupant's, else the first cost_centre rule at its unit that matches; a seat's cost_centre_source says which (position, person, rule or none), and cost_centre_rule is the winning rule's index in the cost_centre list that unit reads. Unit, cost-centre and plan totals always agree. A seat that can't be priced is in `unpriced` with its reason, never counted as zero. Pass unit_id for the working of each seat in that unit. Plans reprice live: bands_changed_at says when a band last changed. Pass the plan's id as scenario_id for Today's run rate: basis is run_rate, period is the year from the base date to the day before the same date a year later, each seat is priced for that whole year, and totals carry only `scenario`, with no baseline or difference, as a run rate is never compared with a period total. A scenario has basis period. pay_view is band_ranges for a member with the see-pay right, whose seat working also shows each band's minimum and maximum, and band_midpoints for everyone else. Totals are the same in both. Figures are decimal strings; people are named by id in `names`. Refused, as an unknown plan, unless the caller is a member.

scenario_id.description: A scenario of the plan, or the plan's id for Today's yearly run rate.

unit_id.description: A unit on the scenario's or the baseline's map, for the working of each seat in it.
